name: Poster Bold
signature: Full-bleed yellow, enormous black type, hard white cards, red buttons.

contrast.note: Yellow page, black text. Red is a fill color only (buttons, badges), never text on the page. White labels on red pass AA.

type.eyebrow: 0.875rem, weight 800, uppercase, 0.1em tracking, ink on a white label

motion.rule: Slam-in: blocks scale from 0.92 to full size in 450ms with a hard 60ms stagger, and a service ticker keeps scrolling between sections.

hero.layout: Headline fills the screen width in near-black on yellow with leading below 0.9. A white photo card with a hard offset shadow tilts -2deg in the corner. One red call button, full width on mobile.
hero.photo: Real photo; shown in a bordered card, never as a full background.

background: Solid yellow. White cards with a 6px hard offset ink shadow. Black 4px rules between sections. No gradients, no textures.

button.shape: Rectangle, 4px radius, 56px tall, full width on mobile.
button.fill: Accent fill, white label, 3px ink border, hard 4px offset shadow.
button.label: Uppercase, weight 800, 0.04em tracking.
button.hover: Press moves the button 2px down-right with data-press.
